Update a prompt

Usage: bn prompt update [OPTIONS] <id>

Arguments:
  <id>

Options:
      --branch <branch>
      --claim[=<claim>]            claim this prompt [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --status <status>            new status
      --actor <actor>              audit actor (overrides $BN_ACTOR)
      --force[=<force>]            allow reassignment or status correction [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --hub <hub>                  hub clone directory (overrides $BEANS_HUB)
      --title <title>              new title
      --json[=<json>]              machine-readable JSON output [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --to <to>                    new recipient
      --no-fetch[=<no-fetch>]      reads: skip the throttled fetch [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --priority <priority>        new priority
      --label <label>              add label (repeatable)
      --no-sync[=<no-sync>]        mutations: commit locally without fetching or pushing [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
      --project <project>          project name (overrides $BEANS_PROJECT and git auto-detection)
      --unlabel <unlabel>          remove label (repeatable)
      --note <note>                audit note
  -d, --description <description>  prompt Markdown
      --body-file <body-file>      read prompt Markdown from file
      --stdin[=<stdin>]            read prompt Markdown from stdin [default: false] [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help                       Print help
